letter.target: Platform Engineer at an invented company
letter.headline: Platform Engineer
letter.subject: A platform your teams can ship on every day
paragraphs: I run the deployment platform of Example Corp, the path every product team takes from the first commit to production. Your posting asks for someone who makes releases calm, and that is the work I do every week.

At Example Corp I replaced a hand kept release checklist with one automated pipeline that tests, packages and announces each release, and I wrote the guides that let other teams take over its daily care.
Before that, at Sample Labs, I built the internal services of a measurement product and moved its test suite to parallel runs, which taught me to treat slow feedback as a defect.
I live in Lyon, speak French and English, and can join on the usual notice. I would be glad to talk about your platform and what it needs next.
